payload.description_html:
line drawing of a large marine reptile swimming underwater with several nautiloids

"Proganthodon overtoni" is a marine reptile known as a mosasaur. It lived during the Cretaceous. Fossils of "Proganthodon" have been found at Chaco Culture National Historical Park, New Mexico.
